fusions.name: Final Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunge at a weakened target that deals 24 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to it. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Spoor Mark
fusions.desc: Throws a marking blow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 35% chance of leaving the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Increases your physical damage by 30% for 12 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Scent of Weakness
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
